name: discovery.consul

arguments.name: allow_stale
arguments.description: Allow stale Consul results. Reduces load on Consul. Refer to the Consul documentation for more information.

arguments.name: bearer_token_file
arguments.description: File containing a bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: bearer_token
arguments.description: Bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: datacenter
arguments.description: Data center to query. If not provided, the default is used.

arguments.name: enable_http2
arguments.description: Whether HTTP2 is supported for requests.

arguments.name: follow_redirects
arguments.description: Whether redirects returned by the server should be followed.

arguments.name: http_headers
arguments.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent along with each request. The map key is the header name.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: Namespace to use. Only supported in Consul Enterprise.

arguments.name: no_proxy
arguments.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses, CIDR notations, and domain names to exclude from proxying.

arguments.name: node_meta
arguments.description: Node metadata key/value pairs to filter nodes for a given service.

arguments.name: partition
arguments.description: Admin partition to use. Only supported in Consul Enterprise.

arguments.name: password
arguments.description: The password to use. Deprecated in favor of the basic_auth configuration.

arguments.name: proxy_connect_header
arguments.description: Specifies headers to send to proxies during CONNECT requests.

arguments.name: proxy_from_environment
arguments.description: Use the proxy URL indicated by environment variables.

arguments.name: proxy_url
arguments.description: HTTP proxy to send requests through.

arguments.name: refresh_interval
arguments.description: Frequency to refresh list of containers.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.description: The scheme to use when talking to Consul.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Host and port of the Consul API.

arguments.name: services
arguments.description: A list of services for which targets are retrieved. If omitted, all services are scraped.

arguments.name: tag_separator
arguments.description: The string by which Consul tags are joined into the tag label.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: An optional list of tags used to filter nodes for a given service. Services must contain all tags in the list.

arguments.name: token
arguments.description: Secret token used to access the Consul API.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: The username to use. Deprecated in favor of the basic_auth configuration.
